question: Why can conceptualization still arise even after initiation removes personal ignorance?
premises: Initiation may remove inner personal ignorance.
Conceptual formations present in the intellect may not yet have ceased.
What remains in the intellect can still give rise to conceptualization.
inference: Therefore initiation alone does not necessarily eliminate all conceptual activity.
plain_english: Even when inner personal ignorance has fallen away through initiation, conceptualization may still arise, because what resides in the intellect has not yet ceased.
